output.summary: An evergreen shrub or small tree native to the Mediterranean Basin and Western Europe. Its rough red berries are edible and sweet when reddish, and they ripen in autumn alongside the next crop of white, bell-shaped flowers.
output.edibilityNote: Red berries are edible and sweet when reddish; eaten fresh but more often made into jam, marmalade, yogurt, brandy and other alcoholic drinks.
